task: Two signaling buoys flash their lights starting at midnight. The first buoy flashes every 4 days, and the second buoy flashes every 6 days. There is a lighthouse nearby that operates only during the day, but it does not affect the buoys' flashing schedule. Counting all the days from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both buoys flash their lights simultaneously?

Two street lamps start flashing at the same moment at noon. One lamp flashes every 4 days, and the other flashes every 6 days. A nearby bakery bakes 20 loaves of bread daily, but this does not affect the lamps. Including the initial flash at noon, how many times do the two lamps flash together within 120 days?

Two assembly lines produce small gadgets. Line X produces 8 gadgets every hour for 4 hours, while Line Y produces 12 gadgets every hour for 5 hours. After all gadgets are made, 25% of the total number of gadgets made by Line X are found defective and discarded. How many non-defective gadgets remain in total after discarding the faulty ones from Line X?

Two bells ring simultaneously at noon today. The first bell rings every 4 days, and the second bell rings every 6 days. There are 12 chairs set up in the room where the bells ring. Counting from day 0 through day 24 inclusive, how many times will both bells ring together?

Two street lamps start flashing simultaneously at midnight. The first lamp flashes every 4 days, and the second lamp flashes every 10 days. A decorative banner was put up on the street, but it does not affect the lamps' flashing schedules. Counting the days from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both lamps flash together?

Two digital billboards start displaying a special advertisement at the same time at noon. One billboard repeats the ad every 4 days, and the other repeats it every 10 days. Including the initial display at noon (day 0) and counting through day 120, how many times will both billboards show the advertisement simultaneously? Note that the 120 days refer to the total period from the start, not the number of repeats for each billboard.

Two garden sprinklers start spraying water simultaneously at 12:00 PM today. One sprinkler sprays every 4 days, and the other sprays every 10 days. Additionally, a bird visits the garden every 3 days, but this does not affect the sprinklers. Counting all the times the sprinklers spray together from day 0 through day 24 inclusive, how many times will both sprinklers spray at the same time?

Two signal beacons start flashing simultaneously at exactly noon today. The first beacon flashes every 4 hours, and the second beacon flashes every 10 hours. Including the initial flash at noon and counting all flashes up to and including the flash at hour 24, how many times will both beacons flash together?

Two garden sprinklers start watering simultaneously at noon. The first sprinkler sprays water every 4 days, and the second sprinkler sprays every 6 days. If the garden is 15 square meters, how many times will both sprinklers spray together from day 0 through day 120 inclusive? Note that the garden size does not affect the timing of the sprinkler sprays.

Factory X produces 18 components every hour and runs for 4 hours, while Factory Y produces 20 components every hour and operates for 5 hours. After all components are made, 25% of the total number of components produced by Factory X are discarded due to defects. How many non-defective components remain in total from both factories?

Two garden sprinklers start spraying water simultaneously at noon. The first sprinkler sprays every 4 days, and the second sprinkler sprays every 6 days. There is also a bird that visits the garden every 5 days, but this does not affect the sprinklers. Including the start day and counting up to day 24, how many times will both sprinklers spray together?

Two digital billboards start their light shows simultaneously at midnight. The first billboard repeats its light pattern every 8 days, while the second repeats every 6 days. Additionally, the city installed a new sound system that plays an unrelated jingle every 5 days, but this does not affect the light patterns. Counting all the times from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both billboards flash their light shows together?

Two street lamps start flashing their lights simultaneously at exactly noon. The first lamp flashes every 8 days, and the second lamp flashes every 6 days. A nearby bakery opens daily at 7 AM but does not affect the flashing schedule. Counting the days from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both lamps flash together?

Two assembly lines produce widgets. Line X produces 8 widgets each hour for 4 hours, and Line Y produces 12 widgets each hour for 5 hours. After production, 25% of the total widgets are discarded due to defects. How many usable widgets are left?

Two signal beacons start flashing simultaneously at midnight today. One beacon flashes every 4 days, and the other flashes every 6 days. Including the initial flash at day 0, how many times will both beacons flash together from day 0 through day 120?

Two signal towers light up simultaneously at noon today. The first tower lights up every 4 days, and the second tower lights up every 6 days. Including the initial lighting at day 0, how many times will both towers light up together from day 0 through day 120?

Two signal towers start transmitting a light pulse simultaneously at noon today. The first tower sends a pulse every 4 days, while the second tower sends a pulse every 6 days. Counting all the days from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both towers send their pulses on the same day?

Two traffic signals at a large intersection start blinking simultaneously at noon. The first signal blinks every 8 days, and the second signal blinks every 10 days. Additionally, a nearby fountain sprays water for 15 minutes every hour, but this detail does not affect the blinking pattern. Counting all the times from day 0 through day 120 inclusive, how many times will both signals blink together?

Two signal towers start flashing their lights simultaneously at noon. One tower flashes every 6 days, while the other flashes every 6 days. A large blue banner is hung near the towers, but it does not affect the flashing schedule. Counting all the times the towers flash together from the starting day through day 24 inclusive, how many times will their lights flash simultaneously?

Two factories manufacture widgets. Factory X produces 8 widgets each hour for 4 hours, and Factory Y produces 12 widgets each hour for 5 hours. After all widgets are made, 25% of them are discarded due to defects. How many widgets are left that are not discarded?

Liam had a collection of rare coins. He gave away one half of his coins, then bought 25 more coins at a coin fair. After these transactions, Liam counted 115 coins in total. How many coins did Liam have initially?

Liam wants to buy a coat priced at $200. He first uses a 25% off coupon on the coat’s price. Then, a 10% sales tax is added to the discounted price. Afterwards, Liam redeems a $20 gift card toward the total. By the way, Liam’s favorite color is blue, but this doesn’t affect the price. How many dollars does Liam still have to pay after all discounts and tax?

Emma purchased a secondhand bicycle for $160 and spent an additional $20 on maintenance. After the maintenance, the bicycle's resale value increased to 125% more than the original purchase price. If Emma sold the bicycle for this new value, what was her total profit after deducting both the initial cost and the maintenance expenses?

At a large conference, 48 attendees participated in the keynote workshop, 57 attended the breakout sessions, and 13 attended both events. Additionally, 10 attendees did not participate in either of these events. How many attendees were there in total at the conference?

In a city library, 48 patrons borrow fiction books, 53 patrons borrow non-fiction books, and 13 patrons borrow both fiction and non-fiction books. Additionally, there are 22 patrons who do not borrow any books. How many patrons are there in total at the library?

At a large conference, 43 attendees are enrolled in the photography workshop, 52 are attending the painting seminar, and 8 participants are signed up for both events. Additionally, 22 attendees are not participating in either workshop. How many attendees are at the conference in total?

A library needs to catalog 530 new books. Each day, the staff spends 10 minutes organizing their workspace before cataloging. They can catalog 4 books each minute and have a maximum of 95 minutes available per day, including setup. The library also received a shipment of 120 magazines, but these do not require cataloging. What is the minimum number of days needed to catalog all the new books?
Lisa took 7 practice tests and had an average score of 70 on them. She then took an eighth test, and her average score increased to 75. What score did she get on the eighth test?

In a community center, 43 people attend yoga classes, 52 people attend painting classes, and 8 people participate in both activities. Additionally, there are 22 people who do not attend either class. How many people are there in total at the community center?

A student took 3 exams and had an average score of 80. After taking a fourth exam, the student's average increased to 85. The student mentioned that the fourth exam was held in a different building than the first three. What was the score on the fourth exam?

Liam started with a certain number of baseball cards. He gave away one-third of his cards, then purchased an additional 25 cards. After these changes, he had a total of 145 baseball cards. How many baseball cards did Liam have originally?

At a community center, 23 children attend the art club, 32 children participate in the music club, and 8 children are members of both clubs. Additionally, there are 22 children who do not join either club. How many children are registered at the community center in total?

In the first quarter, Company X processed 220 shipments and then increased its shipments by 75% in the second quarter. Meanwhile, Company Y started with 200 shipments and increased its shipments by 60% in the same period. How many more shipments did the company with the higher total have after the increase?

Two automated water fountains start spraying at the same time at noon. The first fountain sprays every 4 days, and the second fountain sprays every 10 days. Including the start time at noon, how many times will both fountains spray simultaneously from day 0 through day 120?

Emma wants to buy a computer priced at $360. She first uses a 25% off coupon on the original price. After the discount, a 20% sales tax is added to the reduced price. Finally, Emma applies a $60 store credit to the total after tax. How much money does Emma pay out of pocket after all these adjustments?
Maya had some marbles. She lost one-half of her marbles during recess and later found 25 more marbles on the playground. After that, she had 37 marbles. How many marbles did Maya have before recess?
A class took 7 math tests and the average score was 70. After the class took one more test, the average score rose to 78. What was the score on that additional test?

A factory produced 5 batches of widgets last month with an average of 80 widgets per batch. This month, they made one additional batch, and the average output per batch rose to 85. What was the number of widgets produced in the new batch?

Lena purchased an old bicycle for $160 and spent $40 fixing it up. After the repairs, the bicycle's value increased by 75% compared to the original purchase price. She then sold the bicycle for this new value. How much profit did Lena make after subtracting both the purchase price and the repair costs? Be careful to use the original purchase price as the base for the percentage increase, not the total cost after repairs.

Lena started with a certain number of baseball cards. She gave away one quarter of her collection and then purchased 25 more cards. After these changes, she had 160 cards. Interestingly, her friend also lent her 10 cards, but she returned them immediately, so they did not affect her total count. How many baseball cards did Lena have initially?
